scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,server,worker,web -c blue,green,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @lot-agent/core run dev" "pnpm --filter @lot-agent/server run dev" "pnpm --filter @lot-agent/server run dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @lot-agent/web run dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm --filter @lot-agent/desktop run build && concurrently -n web,electron -c magenta,yellow "pnpm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && pnpm --filter @lot-agent/desktop run dev"
scripts.dist:desktop: pnpm --filter @lot-agent/web run build && pnpm --filter @lot-agent/desktop run dist
scripts.dist:desktop:win: pnpm --filter @lot-agent/web run build && pnpm --filter @lot-agent/desktop run dist:win
scripts.dist:desktop:mac: pnpm --filter @lot-agent/web run build && pnpm --filter @lot-agent/desktop run dist:mac
scripts.test:knowledge: pnpm --filter @lot-agent/core run build && vitest run packages/core/src/knowledge packages/server/src/knowledge packages/server/src/services/agent-service.knowledge-source.test.ts packages/server/src/services/rag-client.test.ts
